description: Create a typed relationship between two of the user's GENERATIONS, e.g. an NPC WORKS_AT a tavern. Directional: source -> target. Suggested types: CONTAINS, LOCATED_IN, MEMBER_OF, RULES, SERVES, ALLIED_WITH, RIVAL_OF, OWNS, WORKS_AT (any short label works). This is the generation library graph - for the campaign co-occurrence graph see chargen_get_relationship_graph, which is read-only. Use chargen_remove_generation_relationship with a relationship_id to remove an edge.

relationship_type.description: Relationship label, e.g. WORKS_AT (max 128 chars, stored uppercase)

name: chargen_relate_generations
title: Relate generations
